course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Exceptions: preserve input and report rejection honestly
goal: Trace an interrupted path, separate conversion from domain validation, and return an explicit result without false success.

prerequisites.text: Complete BSL fundamentals: variables, types, conditions, and loops. Know how to preserve a separate source and run your training infobase.

sections.title: Why this task matters
paragraphs: Invalid text must not silently become a free request. Preserve the original input, explain the reason, and let it be corrected. Distinguish the failing statement, skipped statements, and a separate handling path.

Read the worked example and predict a changed input. The independent task uses a different contract. Save the previous training source before replacing a module; a personal Nexus mark is not an assessment of your explanation.

sections.title: An operation may fail to produce a value
paragraphs: Число("30") produces a number; Число("ошибка") cannot perform the requested conversion. An exception interrupts the ordinary sequence. The remaining instructions in Попытка are skipped and control moves to Исключение. Результат = Истина is therefore not reached in the main example.

The initial flag is Ложь. It represents conversion success in this exercise only, not knowledge assessment, a saved document or permission to accept any number as a duration. Execution after КонецПопытки follows an explicitly chosen recovery path.

sections.title: The complete worked example and its result
paragraphs: ИсходныйТекст contains«ошибка» and the flag starts false. Число cannot produce the expected number, so assignment to true is skipped. The handler displays guidance and the original string remains available.
Match code and result by each statement’s role. Explain matching output through inputs, execution order, and state; one observed run does not check every possible variant.

sections.title: Catch where you can provide a useful response
paragraphs: Keep the risky conversion in a narrow block. Combining many unrelated operations makes the failed action harder to identify. An empty exception handler hides a missing result while allowing the program to appear active.

A learner-facing message should explain the next action and give an example. Developers need reproducible steps and the failure location. Do not automatically publish raw diagnostics containing paths, records or connection details. This exercise retains its synthetic input in a local variable and sends nothing outside.

sections.title: Trace the important transitions
paragraphs: Conversion and acceptable duration are separate checks. Text«-1» can become the number−1 successfully; that does not make a negative duration acceptable. Do not hide both reasons behind an unconditional success message.
Before the next statement, record state separately from messages already displayed. This finds the first divergence rather than guessing from the final line.

sections.title: Your prediction before revealing
paragraphs: Replace«ошибка» with«-1», leaving the worked code unchanged. What is the conversion flag?
Write your answer before revealing it. Identify the changed input and unchanged rule, then compare with the changed example.

reveal.title: Check the prediction
paragraphs: Match the changed values with the same rule. This checks transfer rather than memorisation of the previous final line.
After successful conversion, Истина is displayed as Да in the Russian interface. This is the expected message for the changed input; the actual screenshot below belongs to the original invalid text.

sections.title: Technical conversion is not business validation
paragraphs: The text "-1" can convert successfully. A negative duration still violates our service rule. Check the range after conversion; catching an exception does not replace that check or make an invalid value acceptable.

Distinguish unreadable text, a converted but unacceptable number, and an acceptable number. Zero can be valid under the chosen rule. Returning zero for every failure would erase the distinction between a known value and missing or rejected input.

sections.title: A faulty variant and its first divergence
paragraphs: Setting Результат=true in the exception handler falsely accepts invalid input. An error message does not repair a false success flag. Assign success only after obtaining and validating a result, preserving the original text separately.
Keep the faulty variant separately. Restore the working version and repeat the positive case. Do not change an expectation merely because the program printed something else.

sections.title: Make the failure reproducible
paragraphs: Record input, execution location, action, expected result and actual result. A synthetic string and short message suffice here; no full database, password or borrowed configuration is needed. A result from a different source version does not verify this experiment.

First run invalid text and observe the prompt and Ложь. Change only the input to "30": the prompt should disappear and the flag become Истина. Then investigate "-1" and specify the additional range check. This covers the recovery path and the ordinary path.

sections.title: See the values and direction
paragraphs: The diagram unfolds the selected sequence. Labels do not replace code: match each transition to a statement and record what remains unchanged.

This is the independent parser route: empty input is rejected before conversion. A failed conversion exits through invalid_format. Only a number passing the separate 0…180 range check reaches success. Format and range failures have different causes.

sections.title: How to check transfer
paragraphs: Keep conversion in a narrow try block; check the 0…180 domain separately.
Label each control input, expected observation, and reason in advance. Use rejection where the contract requires it; do not turn an unknown result into a convenient zero.

The source and expected messages accompany the explanation. Actual images of the complete worked example come from a separate training infobase; they are not your run or proof of your authorship. Record your independent work separately.

sections.title: What is established and what still needs explanation
paragraphs: The contract is limited to the specified string inputs and 0…180 range. This is not a universal parser for arbitrary locales. A local rejection does not establish authorship or work in someone’s production infobase.

Before marking completion, explain one changed input of your own. A technical pass, matching messages, and your completion mark are different facts; understanding is discussed through explanation and transfer.

True: conversion succeeded; the domain rule was not checked
